test_title: PYST 30: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 22 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Confession is good for the soul ____________ after the soul has been claimed.
solution:
The correct answer is '4' i.e. even .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence emphasizes a conditional or paradoxical idea that confession is good for the soul, but only under a specific condition.
 
• Out of the given options, the most appropriate word to fill the blank is **'even'** as it introduces a contrast or an unexpected condition.
 
• The phrase **"even after the soul has been claimed"** highlights the surprising or ironic nature of the statement.

Correct sentence: *Confession is good for the soul **even** after the soul has been claimed*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Usage of Options:**

 
 
• **Option 1 (since):** Indicates a reason or cause, which does not fit the context here.
 
• **Option 2 (though):** Expresses a contrast but does not suit the sentence structure.
 
• **Option 3 (still):** Implies continuation but lacks the emphasis required in the sentence.
